integrity: All displayed identities were reconstructed from the stated normalized vector field and replayed by exact symbolic algebra. Literature comparisons distinguish the known n=0 first integral from the n>0 stationary-measure consequences. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and gives no existence, uniqueness, ergodicity, mixing-rate, or physical-measure result. The slab-crossing conclusion is qualitative. The earliest 2004 source date is verified through later bibliographic records identifying the public conference dates; the 2004 proceedings full text was not required for the proof comparison.
title: Stationary height circle and slab-crossing recurrence in the T-system
